observation.visible_scene: A tall, narrow vertical column made of horizontally stacked wooden planks (with a brick-like grain and a few pale bands) stands centered against a pure black background. Flames burn around the column: a brighter flame plume rises above the top edge, occasional flame tongues lick the left and right sides at mid-height, and a small steady flame sits at the bottom-left corner of the stack.
visible_changes: The wooden column stays in the same position and size from the first to the last frame; it does not shift, tilt, collapse, or change its plank layout.

The flame plume above the top of the column continuously flickers, changes shape, and varies in height and brightness across the frames (e.g., broad bright tongues early, thinner wisps in the middle, brighter loops near the end).
Side flame tongues on the left and right edges appear, fade, and reappear at different heights and moments rather than being constant.
The small flame at the bottom-left corner of the column remains present throughout the excerpt.
The overall intensity of the top flame fluctuates but the burning process is ongoing at both the start and the end of the clip; no ignition onset or extinguishing is shown.
outside_clip_unknowns: What ignited the column and the conditions before this segment.
Whether the column eventually burns down, collapses, or remains standing after this excerpt.
The full extent of the structure below the bottom frame edge.
uncertain_details: Camera appears static (the column's position and scale are unchanged), but background is featureless black so subtle camera motion cannot be fully ruled out.
Any gradual charring or darkening of the wood over time is not clearly distinguishable from lighting changes caused by the flickering flames.
